'''''Crosscurrent''''' is a novel by [[Paul S. Kemp]] that was released on [[January 26]], [[2010]]. It takes place during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]<ref name="Sue">{{Blog|eeusuestornii|11|A bit about the new novels.....}}</ref> as well as after the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series and features [[Jaden Korr]] as a lead character.<ref name="PSKBlog1">{{WebCite|url=http://paulskemp.livejournal.com/204377.html|text=More on the Star Wars novel|work=Blog of Author Paul S. Kemp|nobackup=1}}</ref> It also ties in to ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=08895#17646435|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2009-06-02|time=2:09 PM}}</ref> [[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']] is a direct sequel, picking up immediately after the end of ''Crosscurrent''.
